ignoreValues.reason: Claude triage 2026-08-29: all 7 uppercase rules are micro-labels, not body text — .pill 9.5px, .tk dt 10px ('acceptance'/'evidence'), .states .lbl 10px ('state'), .filters .lbl 10.5px, th 10.5px, .eyebrow 11px, all letter-spaced. The rule's own carve-out ('reserve uppercase for short labels and headings') covers every instance; no passage is set in caps.

Claude triage 2026-08-29: part of a deliberate, consistently applied three-face system on an already-published artifact - Archivo (sans), Instrument Serif (display only, .eyebrow/headings), DM Mono (mono/labels). Not a default pick. NOT user-confirmed; suppressed because changing the typeface of a board Paul is actively working from is an identity change, out of scope for functional edits, and riskier than the warning. Revisit if the board is ever restyled deliberately.
